_doc: Bowmaster line (spec #332, ticket B2 #334). The second class line after Hero: its job entry, its AP row and its weapon families. Skill definitions are in skills/bowmaster.json; each Bowmaster skill ticket (B7-B11) appends its own. Bowmaster has NO mobility_skill (ruling D1, spec #332): a Bowmaster owns no skill key and no quick-slot movement cell. playable stays false until B12/B13 flip it; JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job).

312._starting_skill: tier C: spec #332: Arrow Blow is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; its WZ source is skills/bowman.json (book 300 -> 310 Arrow Bomb).
312._skill_pool: tier C: spec #332: the ten hand-picked Bowmaster actives from the 300/310/311/312 books (all auto-cast). Undefined keys stay inert until their tickets define them.
312._weapon_families: tier C: spec #332: bows only (WeaponInfo family bow, 145xxxx); crossbows (146xxxx) belong to Marksman. Armour and shields drop by the Bowman class bit.
312._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #332: the War Bow (reqJob 4, the Bowman bit), wearable at creation.
312._provenance: tier C: spec #332 B2 #334: the Bowmaster data line; not selectable until B12/B13.

312._ap: tier C: spec #332: the Bowman (300) row copied verbatim (the Bowman gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 312 no longer falls back through 310/300.
